item.title: Record temps send Chicagoans outdoors — and to car wash lines
item.description: <p>The temperature hits a record high in February, and where’s your first stop?</p><p>The obvious answer: The car wash.</p><p>People all over Chicago used Monday’s warm weather to turn their cars from salty reminders of winter to shiny and spring-ready vehicles. item.title: Obama shuts down alien buzz and says there's no evidence they've made contact with earthlings
item.description: <p>Former U.S. President Barack Obama said he did not see evidence that aliens “have made contact with us,” after sending social media abuzz by saying aliens were real on a podcast over the weekend.</p><p>During a lightning round of questions with podcast host Brian Tyler Cohen, Obama was asked, “Are aliens real?”</p><p>“They’re real,” he answered, continuing: “But I haven’t seen them.
